note: 3D models for Frostwing, made on Higgsfield on 2026-11-11. Each began as an original GPT Image 2.6 product render on a grey background. The two ships went through Meshy 7 image-to-3D (textured, PBR, symmetry on, 12,000 triangles). The props went through Tripo H3.1 image-to-3D (PBR). All were packed with higgsfield/models3d/pack-ship.mjs: centred, scaled, turned to face -z, simplified, WebP textures, meshopt-compressed (decoder: ../lib/meshopt_decoder.mjs).

gate.remark: Tripo kept the two pillars and dropped the lintel; the game uses it as a broken gate you can fly through

varrow.remark: gas giant on black; art/varrow.webp gets its alpha from brightness
